sn12.17:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn12.17:1.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
sn12.17:1.4: addasā kho acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
sn12.17:1.5: disvāna yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn12.17:1.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn12.17:1.7: puccheyyāma mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ kañcideva desaṃ, sace no bhavaṃ gotamo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti.
sn12.17:2.1: dutiyampi kho acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn12.17:2.2: puccheyyāma mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ kañcideva desaṃ, sace no bhavaṃ gotamo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti.
sn12.17:2.5: tatiyampi kho acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca: puccheyyāma mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ kañcideva desaṃ, sace no bhavaṃ gotamo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti. akālo kho tāva kassapa pañhassa,
sn12.17:2.8: na kho pana mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ bahudeva pucchitukāmāti.
sn12.17:3.1: kinnu kho bho gotama, sayaṃkataṃ dukkhanti?
sn12.17:3.5: kinnu kho bho gotama, sayaṃkatañca paraṃkataṃca dukkhanti?
sn12.17:3.7: kimpana bho gotama, asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃ kāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ dukkhanti?
sn12.17:3.9: kinnu kho bho gotama, natthi dukkhanti.
sn12.17:3.12: tena hi bhavaṃ gotamo dukkhaṃ na jānāti na passatīti?
sn12.17:3.13: nakhvāhaṃ kassapa, dukkhaṃ na jānāmi, na passāmi.
sn12.17:4.1: ‘kinnu kho bho gotama, sayaṃkataṃ dukkha’nti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ kassapā’ti vadesi.
sn12.17:4.2: ‘kimpana bho gotama paraṃkataṃdukkha’nti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ kassapā’ti vadesi. ‘kinnu kho bho gotama, sayaṃkatañca parakatañca dukkha’nti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ kassapā’ti vadesi.
sn12.17:4.4: adhiccasamuppannaṃ dukkha’nti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ kassapā’ti vadesi.
sn12.17:4.5: ‘kinnu kho bho gotama natthi dukkha’nti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho kassapa natthi dukkhaṃ, atthi kho kassapa dukkha’nti vadesi.
sn12.17:4.6: ‘tena hi bhavaṃ gotamo dukkhaṃ na jānāti, na passatī’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na khvāhaṃ kassapa, dukkhaṃ na jānāmi, na passāmi.
sn12.17:5.1: “so karoti so paṭisaṃvediyatī”ti kho kassapa, ādito sato “sayaṃ kataṃ dukkha”nti iti vadaṃ sassataṃ etaṃ pareti.
sn12.17:5.2: “añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvediyatī”ti kho kassapa, vedanābhitunnassa sato “paraṃkataṃ dukkha”nti iti vadaṃ ucchedaṃ etaṃ pareti.
sn12.17:5.3: ete te kassapa, ubho ante anupagamma majjhena tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti:
sn12.17:6.1: evaṃ vutte acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn12.17:6.3: seyyathāpi bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya …pe… cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti. evamevaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito,
sn12.17:6.4: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
sn12.17:6.5: labheyyāhambhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn12.17:7.1: yo kho kassapa, aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ. ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ, so cattāro māse parivasati. catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena parivutthaparivāsaṃ āraddhacittā bhikkhū. ākaṅkhamānā pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya,
sn12.17:8.1: sace bhante, aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena parivutthaparivāse āraddhacittā bhikkhū ākaṅkhamānā pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya, ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi, catunnañca vassānaṃ accayena parivutthaparivāsaṃ āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyāti.
sn12.17:9.1: alattha kho acelo kassapo bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ. alattha upasampadaṃ.
sn12.17:9.2: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
sn12.17:9.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn12.17:9.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā kassapo arahataṃ ahosīti.
